sections.title: Security
items: Updates now install only when a signed release manifest authorises them.
The updater waits for the exact GameHQ process that started the update, never a lookalike.
An update archive is accepted only if its name, size, and checksum match that signature.
The updater re-checks the signature itself before it replaces a single file.
A failed handoff now changes nothing and leaves GameHQ ready to try again.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Playnite state no longer disappears shortly after the plugin reconnects.
The local connection now closes cleanly instead of sending a damaged message.

sections.title: Changed
items: The published .sha256 file is now only for checking a download by hand.
A release without its signature file is no longer offered for one-click install.
